guest.line1: Udlala njengesivakashi — ukuqhubeka kwakho kulondolozwa kulesi siphequluli.
language.coverage: Ukuzulazula namazwibela omdlalo kuhunyushiwe. Okunye okuqukethwe komsebenzi kusebenzisa ulimi olungolunye.
language.hint: Sesha ngegama lendabuko, igama elihunyushiwe noma ikhodi yolimi.
match.eventsEmpty: Okwenzekayo kuzovela lapha uma umdlalo usuqalile.
narration.hint: Landela yonke imizuzu ebalulekile ngezwi, ngamazwibela noma ngakho kokubili.
narration.title: Ukuphawula namazwibela
narration.unavailable: Alikho izwi lesiphequluli lalolu limi. Amazwibela asatholakala.
nav.searchHint: Thayipha igama lesigaba, bese usikhetha ukuze uye kuso.
quick.description: Khetha iqembu lakho nomphikisi. Ikhompyutha ilawula elinye iqembu. Umsebenzi wakho awuthinteki.
quick.hint: Ifomu, ukuqina komzimba namasu nakho kuthinta umphumela.
quick.title: Umdlalo osheshayo
screen.noCareerHint: Khetha ikilabhu, wakhe iqembu lakho bese uqala isizini.

studio.cameraHint: Hudula ukuze uzungezise, noma usebenzise izinkinobho zekhamera. Zonke izilawuli zisebenza ngekhibhodi.
studio.clothHint: Qhathanisa indlela ikhithi enemininingwane enyakaza ngayo lapho umdlali egijima, ephenduka futhi efika phansi.
studio.phaseHint: Misa kunoma yiliphi ifreyimu ukuze uhlole ukwesekwa nokuthintana.
studio.title: Yonke imininingwane yomdlali.
